band_notes.55_60_empty_by_construction: The registered broad 40% cutoff is 0.6213299999999999, so no marginal selection can have confidence below 0.62133. The [0.55,0.60) band is reported as a measured zero, not omitted.
band_notes.70_plus_sparse_by_construction: The registered narrow 20% cutoff is 0.7070145 and narrow picks are removed from marginal, so values above 0.7070145 cannot appear. The 0.70-0.75 band contains only 0.70-0.7070.

class_census.itf_separation: NOT_POSSIBLE: no ITF/FUT result is ingested. SHORT_CAREER_ITF_OR_DEBUT is a union, not a split.

cluster_bootstrap.interpretation: A design effect above 1 means the naive independent SD understates the uncertainty of the winner count.

expected_winner_variance.limitation: sum p(1-p) is exact only for independent Bernoulli selections. Selections share favourites, opponents and tournament conditions; the cluster bootstrap is the dependence-aware estimate and still cannot capture unobserved shared shocks.

identity.note: The existing bridge resolves live-only IDs through persisted bridges and unique TENNIS_DATA aliases. A zero count for non-live source rows is not evidence of missing identity; the bridge is an alias-uniqueness resolver, not a provider census.
